title: Danganronpa 2x2 Game's Switch 2 Release Changed to Game-Key Card
content: Spike Chunsoft announced on Wednesday that the Switch 2 release of Danganronpa 2x2 , a version of its Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair game that includes the original title as well as a new alternate scenario, will shift to a game-key card release instead of a full game card.
author: ANN

title: The World’s Strongest Witch Reveals Main Trailer, Visual and Additional Cast, October 7 Premiere
content: The World’s Strongest Witch anime has revealed its main trailer and visual ahead of its October 7, 2026 premiere. Yuto Uemura has also joined the cast as Reinhardt. Joji Furuta is directing the anime , with Shoji Yonemura in charge of the series composition and Yuki Morimoto as character designer.
author: Anime Corner

title: One Piece Elbaph Arc English Dub Begins October 20 With New Weekly Release Schedule, Heroines Dub Also Announced
content: Toei Animation and Crunchyroll have announced that the ONE PIECE English dub will begin the Elbaph Arc on October 20, 2026, alongside a change to its release schedule. The companies also confirmed English, Spanish and Portuguese dubs for the ONE PIECE HEROINES episode.
author: Anime Corner

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Previews Story in New Trailer
content: Atlus revealed a new trailer on Wednesday for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, outlining the game's story. English Trailer Japanese Trailer The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC with Xbox Game Pass, and PC via Steam on February 18, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Bungo Stray Dogs STORM BRINGER Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Author's Health
content: The October issue of Kadokawa 's Shōnen Ace magazine revealed on Wednesday that Shiwasu Hoshikawa 's Bungo Stray Dogs STORM BRINGER manga will go on a long-term hiatus due to Hoshikawa's health. The magazine will reveal when the manga will continue in a later issue.
author: ANN

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo's Shun Numa, Teenage Renaissance! David's Yūshin Kuroki Launch New Manga
content: This year's 39th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that manga authors Shun Numa ( Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ) and Yūshin Kuroki ( Teenage Renaissance! David ) will launch a new manga titled Ura no Report (Ura's Report) in the magazine's next issue on August 31.
author: ANN
